reach.label: Reachable from other devices

reach.checkAgainLabel: Check again whether other devices reach {{machine}}

ok.problem: Your other devices can reach this machine.

brokerOff.problem: The connection service is off, so devices outside this network cannot reach the machine.
brokerOff.fix: Turn the connection service on above.

brokerUnreachable.problem: The machine cannot reach the connection service, so devices outside this network cannot find it.
brokerUnreachable.fix: Check the internet connection of the machine, and whether a firewall or proxy blocks {{broker}}.

noRelay.problem: The connection service offers no relay, so devices on some networks cannot connect.
noRelay.fix: Use a connection service with a relay, such as the default one.

turnUnreachable.problem: The relay does not answer, so devices on some networks cannot connect.
turnUnreachable.fix: Let the machine reach the relay through its firewall, on UDP 3478 and TCP 3478 or 5349.

turnRefused.problem: The relay refuses the machine, so devices on some networks cannot connect.
turnRefused.fix: If you run the connection service yourself, give it the secret its relay expects. On the default one, try again later.

udpBlocked.problem: This network blocks the direct route, so every connection goes through the relay and is slower.
udpBlocked.fix: Allow outgoing UDP on this network, at least to port 3478.

vpnRelayed.problem: {{tunnel}} blocks the direct route, so every connection goes through the relay and is slower.
vpnRelayed.fix: Let Ruimte bypass the VPN, turn off the exit node, or allow UDP through it.

vpnBlocked.problem: {{tunnel}} blocks the routes other devices need, so they cannot connect.
vpnBlocked.fix: Let Ruimte bypass the VPN, turn off the exit node, or allow UDP through it.

blocked.problem: This network blocks the routes other devices need, so they cannot connect.
blocked.fix: Check the firewall or proxy of this network. It has to allow UDP, or TCP to the relay on port 3478 or 5349.

lanDoorDown.problem: Port {{port}} is taken, so devices on this network connect through your account.
lanDoorDown.fix: Stop what uses the port, or start the machine with another --lan-port.

unknown.problem: The machine reports a problem this version of Ruimte does not know: {{cause}}.

continue.label: Continue automatically

rounds.label: Steps per run
rounds.description: Steps before a run stops, 5 to 200.

runs.label: Runs in a row
runs.description: Runs a chat starts by itself, 1 to 20. Each run is billed.

tokens.label: Output tokens per reply
tokens.description: The most a reply may use, 1,024 to 128,000, within the model's limit. Thinking counts too.

enabled.label: Pets
enabled.description: A small figure on every agent shows what it does, and jumps when it needs you. Click a pet to go to its node.

place.label: Where pets are
place.description: On their nodes, or roaming the bottom of the screen.

subagents.label: Sub-agents
subagents.description: A smaller figure walks along with a pet for each sub-agent at work, up to three.

visitor.label: Visitor
visitor.description: While Pets is off, a pet now and then drops by beside a node for a few seconds.

sprite.label: Figures
sprite.description: Pick one or more sets. Each agent keeps one figure. Claude and Codex have their own, other agents use Claude's.

custom.label: Your own figures
custom.description: A PNG or WebP strip of square frames side by side. Up to {{frames}} frames of {{size}} pixels, {{kilobytes}} KB at most.

inViews.label: In views of their own
